name: 28403 · Wilmington, NC
findings: ZIP 28403 (Wilmington) has 225 nonprofit organizations. 120 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28403 (Wilmington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
